review.reason: The answer’s core chain—AI data center Power requirement → power rail-related measurement/analysis → MXO mapped to power rail analysis—is a fair synthesis of passages [21] and [23], and it appropriately cautions that PCB IL/TDR parameters are mapped to ZNA/ZNB rather than directly to an oscilloscope. Some wording goes beyond the passages because the cited text names MXO but does not itself identify MXO as an oscilloscope or establish all listed parameters as oscilloscope requirements.
